<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 640 400" width="640" height="400" font-family="Consolas, 'Courier New', monospace" font-size="15" xmlns:c2pa="http://c2pa.org/manifest"><metadata><c2pa:manifest></c2pa:manifest></metadata>
  <rect width="640" height="400" fill="#ffffff"/>

  <!-- klassebox -->
  <rect x="40" y="30" width="560" height="340" fill="#f8f9fa" stroke="#1f2937" stroke-width="2"/>

  <!-- naamvak -->
  <text x="320" y="68" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold" font-size="20" fill="#111827">Speler</text>
  <line x1="40" y1="90" x2="600" y2="90" stroke="#1f2937" stroke-width="2"/>

  <!-- attributen -->
  <text x="56" y="120" fill="#111827">- naam : String</text>
  <text x="56" y="146" fill="#111827">- trofeeen : int</text>
  <text x="56" y="172" fill="#111827">- townhallNiveau : int</text>
  <line x1="40" y1="192" x2="600" y2="192" stroke="#1f2937" stroke-width="2"/>

  <!-- methodes -->
  <text x="56" y="222" fill="#111827">+ Speler(naam : String, trofeeen : int, townhallNiveau : int)</text>
  <text x="56" y="250" fill="#111827">+ getNaam() : String</text>
  <text x="56" y="276" fill="#111827">+ getTrofeeen() : int</text>
  <text x="56" y="302" fill="#111827">+ getTownhallNiveau() : int</text>
  <text x="56" y="328" fill="#111827">+ voegTrofeeenToe(extraTrofeeen : int) : void</text>
  <text x="56" y="354" font-size="12" fill="#6b7280">(naam en townhallNiveau zijn final)</text>
</svg>
